author: jeffy7878
quote:
A game's visual beauty has never determined its overall quality. In 2026, 30 FPS is quite simply a rip-off; there hasn't been a single presentation on Xbox, and for good reason—it looks terrible and runs choppily, making it unplayable on the Series X. Furthermore, the marketing—pre-orders and all—is simply unbearable.
Also, paying 80 euros to watch a slideshow is completely unacceptable.
